plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full meadowid system, prioritizing the primary settings/privacy flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
plan.summary: The exploration will systematically traverse the MeadowID dashboard, starting with the overview's security alerts and recovery prompts, then moving through connected apps, sessions, and passkeys to validate interactive controls and risk mitigations. It will then validate the multi-step data export wizard and the high-stakes account freeze flow. Finally, the entire suite of critical paths will be re-evaluated on a mobile viewport to assess responsive layout and tap target issues identified in the prescan.
assumptions: The local demo supports interactive state changes such as dismissing alerts, revoking apps, ending sessions, and toggling the freeze switch.
The data-export.html page functions as a multi-step wizard with 'Continue' and 'Back' navigation.
Profile and Billing links (href='#') are placeholder links and will not navigate to new content.
Small tap targets flagged in the prescan will cause significant usability issues on mobile viewports.
risk_hotspots: Revoke button on connected-apps.html: requires confirmation dialog; critical to ensure users don't accidentally lose access.
End all other sessions button on devices.html: highly destructive action with no apparent confirmation step in the prescan.
Freeze switch on freeze.html: high-stakes toggle that blocks all authentication; must validate clarity and reversibility.
Reveal & download backup codes on passkeys.html: sensitive data exposure mechanism.
Small tap targets across all pages: nav links and inline actions (e.g., 'Dismiss all', 'verify now') are below 44px mobile guidance.

phases.title: Dashboard Overview & Alerts
phases.objective: Validate the main dashboard layout, security alert interactions, and recovery readiness prompts.
key_checks: Click 'Run security check' button and observe feedback.
Dismiss individual alerts and the 'Dismiss all' link; verify they disappear.
Click inline action links ('Review', 'Add passkey', 'Open') to ensure they navigate correctly to devices.html, passkeys.html, and connected-apps.html.
Click 'verify now' and 'Configure' links to check for modal dialogs or navigation.
Verify 'See all' navigates to devices.html.
exit_criteria: All inline action links on the overview are clicked and verified.
Navigation to subpages from overview tiles is confirmed.

phases.title: App & Session Management
phases.objective: Test filtering, searching, and destructive actions for connected apps and active sessions.
key_checks: Use the search input and category/sort dropdowns on connected-apps.html.
Click 'Revoke' on an app and validate the confirmation dialog and resulting state.
Click 'End all other sessions' on devices.html and validate confirmation and state change.
Click on a specific session row/pin on devices.html to view its details.
exit_criteria: Search and filter controls function correctly on connected-apps.html.

phases.title: Security & Recovery Configuration
phases.objective: Validate passkey management, 2FA backup factors, and recovery settings interactions.
key_checks: Click '+ Add a passkey' and observe the registration flow/dialog.
Click 'Remove' on a passkey and validate confirmation.
Click 'Re-pair' on the authenticator app and observe behavior.
Click 'Reveal & download' for backup codes and verify masking/unmasking.
Interact with the recovery email and trusted contact inputs and actions ('Send verification').
exit_criteria: Recovery email and contact actions are triggered.

phases.title: Data Export & Account Freeze
phases.objective: Exercise the multi-step data export wizard and the high-stakes account freeze toggle.
key_checks: Navigate through all 4 steps of the data export wizard using 'Continue' and 'Back'.
Toggle checkboxes for export categories and verify estimated size updates.
Click 'Save as draft' during the export flow.
Toggle the freeze switch on freeze.html and validate warnings/state changes.
Click 'Request deletion' and verify it triggers a confirmation or expected behavior.
exit_criteria: Data export wizard is traversed to the final review step.
Freeze toggle is switched on and off.

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Re-test critical flows and layout on a mobile viewport, focusing on tap targets and responsive navigation.
key_checks: Verify sidebar navigation collapses or adapts for mobile on index.html.
Attempt to tap small targets ('Dismiss all', 'Review', 'verify now') to assess usability.
Test the connected apps search/filter and revoke flow on mobile.
Test the freeze toggle on mobile to ensure it is easily operable.
exit_criteria: Mobile layout is visually verified for key pages.
Small tap targets are interacted with and critiqued.
Critical destructive actions (Revoke, Freeze) are validated on mobile.

coverage_targets.pages: visit all 6 known HTML pages and traverse all wizard steps
coverage_targets.features: exercise all visible buttons, dropdowns, search inputs, and inline action links; trigger all destructive action confirmations
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat critical checks and layout validations on mobile viewport, specifically auditing the flagged small tap targets

notes: Profile and Billing links point to '#' and are expected to be dead ends; limit time spent on them.
Pay close attention to the absence of input labels on connected-apps.html as flagged by layout warnings.

prescan_summary.title: Freeze account — MeadowID
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: MeadowID ◐ Overview ⇄ Connected apps ▢ Active sessions ⌘ Passkeys & 2FA ↓ Export your data ❄ Freeze account JT Jamal Tarrant jamal@thirdpond.dev Freeze account A freeze is the strongest, reversible version of "stop everything." We use it for incidents. It is not the same as deleting your account. What freezing does Every connected app is signed out and rejected until you unfreeze. New tokens cannot be issued. Sign-ins are blocked from every device. You'll need your password and a passkey or backup code to unfreeze. Subscriptions, automatic backups, and recurring data exports are paused. Your data is not deleted. Nothing is shared with apps. You stay billed only if a free trial is converting. What freezing does not do It does not remove sessions on third-party servers that don't honor token revocation (extremely rare; we report these). It does not freeze accounts you opened with email/pas
